question: The deadly terrorist attacks targeting Christian communities in these three countries call for a substantive European response. In Karak, Jordan, nine people were killed in a terrorist attack on the Greek Orthodox church of Saint George. In Ethiopia, at least 60 Orthodox Christians were killed in two attacks in Oromia in October.

In Nigeria, Christians continue to be victims of killings, abductions and forced displacement. The protection of life and religious freedom must be a priority of European foreign policy. Christian communities are entitled to freely exercise their faith and safely remain in their ancestral homes.
In view of the above, can the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy answer the following: 1.
What diplomatic initiatives has she taken vis-à-vis the authorities of these three countries to protect Christian communities and bring those responsible to justice?
What EU support does she intend to mobilise to protect places of worship, support victims and ensure the safe return of displaced persons?
How does she assess the effectiveness of protection measures and how does she take their impact into account in the EU’s relations with the countries concerned?
